items.briefing:
Australian e-learning platform Mathspace has disclosed a data breach affecting over one million people, so staff who use or have used the platform should monitor their accounts and be alert for phishing emails using their personal details. Separately, scammers are increasingly impersonating popular figures like MrBeast to trick people into clicking fake links or handing over money — be sceptical of any unsolicited offers tied to celebrity names, particularly on social media.

The Australian Cyber Security Centre has also warned about critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler products commonly used in Australian organisations — IT teams should ensure these are patched promptly.

**Practical tip:** If you receive a message claiming you've won a prize or giveaway, don't click any links — go directly to the official website to verify.

featured.title: Microsoft tightens AI governance as agentic risks rise
featured.summary: Stricter controls on agent identities and tool access aim to curb security and reliability risks as autonomous AI systems spread.
